name: na.remove
title: Drops missing rows and records the 1-based positions. A time series rebuilds tsp from the remaining span.

origin.description: Drops missing rows and records the 1-based positions. A time series rebuilds tsp from the remaining span.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: Drops missing rows and records the 1-based positions. A time series rebuilds tsp from the remaining span.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
nr <- na.remove(c(1, NA, 3, NA, 5))
tz <- na.remove(ts(c(1, NA, 3, 4, NA, 6), start = c(2000, 1), frequency = 4))
paste(join(nr), paste(attr(nr, "na.removed"), collapse = ","), join(as.numeric(tz)),
      paste(attr(tz, "na.removed"), collapse = ","), paste(vapply(tsp(tz), cell, ""), collapse = ","), sep = "|")
